description: This header file declares functions for encrypting and decrypting data using TPM (Trusted Platform Module) hardware within the Android Cuttlefish project. It provides interface definitions for TpmEncrypt and TpmDecrypt functions, which handle cryptographic operations with associated parameters such as context, key handle, authorization, IV, and data buffers.

methods.name: TpmEncrypt
methods.description: Encrypts input data using TPM with specified key handle and authorization, outputting encrypted data. Takes ESYS context, key handle, authorization, IV, input buffer, output buffer, and data size as parameters.

methods.name: TpmDecrypt
methods.description: Decrypts input data using TPM with specified key handle and authorization, outputting plaintext data. Takes ESYS context, key handle, authorization, IV, input buffer, output buffer, and data size as parameters.
